metadata.description: Riad Chaban's plugin marketplace. Discovery OS and the Tracking Planner: product discovery and evidence-graded tracking plans for Claude Code, Codex and any agent that reads skills. Given away at ProductTank Syria, 2026.

plugins.name: discovery-os
plugins.description: Product discovery for AI agents, done properly. Seven skills: a routing commander with a seventeen-rule constitution, interviewing, synthesis, quantitative analysis with five tested scripts, experiments, prototyping with working artifacts, and discovery operations. It picks the method that fits the evidence you have, and it will not invent a customer, a number, or a confidence level.

plugins.name: tracking-planner
plugins.description: Tracking plans written from evidence, not from memory. Walks your app hands-on, an Android emulator, an iOS simulator, a browser or a Figma file, screenshots every surface, and builds a product-analytics tracking plan from what it actually sees. Every event is graded by evidence, parameters group into reusable attribute packs, sibling events consolidate, and the output is a phased, buildable Excel workbook with the screenshots embedded. GA4 and Firebase first, with destination rules for Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog and Segment.
